resources.string: Agenda
Today and the week ahead from P Calendar. Works with no signal.
Tasks
Today\'s and overdue tasks. Tick them off, even with no signal.
Notes
Your pinned and latest notes, with a note, list or voice note a tap away. Works with no signal.
One note
A note or list you choose. Tick items off, even with no signal.
Photo
A photo from an album you choose, in the shape you like. A new one every half hour, even with no signal.
App panel
Your Promptly apps in one place, with unread and due counts. Choose which apps.
Talk
One big microphone: tap it to talk to Promptly.
Quick add
A new note, task, photo or voice note, one tap each.
Today
Weather, what\'s next and when to leave, tasks due and birthdays. Read me my day.
Meals & Macros
Calories and protein left today, and Log food.
Rooms and Porch
Unread messages and the newest Porch photo.
Favourite people
The people you choose, a tap from a message or a call.
P Maps
Home and Work in today\'s traffic, and when to leave for your next event.
On their way
Who\'s sharing a trip with you, and when they\'ll get there.
Countdown
Days until a day you choose: a holiday, a birthday.
Health
Your weight trend, Log weight, and your next workout.
Mail
Unread mail and who it\'s from.
